description: Validates database backup jobs for schedule validity, retention policy, checksum generation, no literal credentials, and encryption + storage destination compliance

rules.description: db-backup-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare command, destination, schedule, and retentionCount
The schedule field must be a valid 5-field cron expression or a recognised shorthand. Each field is validated against its allowed range
At least one of retentionCount or retentionDays must be declared and be a positive integer. Without a retention policy, backups accumulate indefinitely, filling storage and incurring unbounded cost
Backup specs should enable checksum generation so backup integrity can be verified after upload. Backups without checksums cannot be confirmed as uncorrupted
Database connection strings and passwords must be supplied via environment variable references — no literal credential values in the spec. Hardcoded credentials appear in CI logs and source control
db-backup-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

Backup encryption must be configured (encryptionEnabled: true or encryptionKey declared) or skipped with skipEncryptionCheck: true and justification. A storage destination (storageDestination or storageClass) must be declared for auditability

constraints.encryption: encryptionEnabled: true or encryptionKey must be declared (or skipEncryptionCheck: true with justification)
constraints.storage-destination: storageDestination or storageClass must be declared
